_meta.description: Monster skill definitions. IDs referenced by monster_archetypes.json and monsters.json. Loaded by ContentLoader::load_monster_skills() at boot.
_meta.format_note: Same format as classes/{class}/skills.json — parsed by ContentLoader::parse_skill()
_meta.scaling_note: Monster skills scale via tier_multipliers in monster_skills_scaling.json, NOT percent_per_level
_meta.cast_time_note: cast_time in seconds. Minimum 1.0s (all skills interruptible). Fillers: 1.0-1.5s, basic/advanced: 1.5-4.0s, signatures: 3.0-7.0s. See monster_archetypes.json cast_time_system.
_meta.skill_count: 60 skills: 4 basic mob + 16 role basics (8 rôles × 2) + 8 archetypes × (4 pool + 1 signature)

basic_skills.description_en: Grants +15% ATK to allies in the row for 8s. The call that gathers the herd and drives it forward.

basic_skills.description_en: Deals 100% ATK physical damage and stuns the target for 1.5s. The skull is built for this, the body merely follows.

basic_skills.description_en: Deals 100% ATK physical damage to two targets and slows them for 4s. A mass that moves forward without asking what is in the way.

basic_skills.description_fr: Confere +9% esquive pendant 6s. Trois bonds sans logique, et la trajectoire est deja ailleurs.
basic_skills.description_en: Grants +9% evasion for 6s. Three unpredictable bounds, and the line is already elsewhere.

basic_skills.description_fr: Confere +15% reduction de degats aux allies de la ligne pendant 6s. Le cerf se place devant, bois baisses, et le reste du groupe se range derriere.

basic_skills.description_fr: Inflige 110% ATK degats physiques et retire 15% ATK pendant 8s. Il s'accroche au bras et ne le lache plus.
basic_skills.description_en: Deals 110% ATK physical damage and strips 15% ATK for 8s. It latches onto the arm and does not let go.
